The owner's first example (docs/decisions.md:156): listed on the Isle of Wight, the seller says
collection is in Manchester, and the buyer could not see and pay there ("No"). The same advert is
copied in Chichester and Manchester. Design §3.2: location reports are re-measured from each
member, so the report counts on the Isle of Wight (own) and Chichester (copy), but not on the
Manchester copy, where it agrees with the listing. Synthetic: points are town centroids.
